title: Colts have plenty to evaluate after preseason opener tie with Patriots

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts have plenty to evaluate after preseason opener tie with Patriots
sources.description: For the Indianapolis Colts, the 13-13 preseason opener stalemate does not reflect the numerous missed opportunities to step on the necks of the reining AFC-champions, punch the ball into the end zone, or for either quarterback to claim their job on the depth chart. The Colts turned the ball over four times through the first […]
